stages.label: Local recording and visible stop
stages.notes: Installed /Applications runtime evidence covers Record, Pause, Resume, Stop, latest artifact validation, and visible local capture truth.

stages.label: Local artifact finalization and leakage gate
stages.notes: Finalization truth gate is accepted for dual-track packages.

stages.label: Upload queue and server ingest
stages.notes: Desktop upload queue and server-mediated ingest are accepted foundations.

stages.label: MediaScribe processing and result import
stages.notes: Processing pipeline is accepted; desktop clients still do not hold MediaScribe credentials.

stages.label: Meeting list
stages.notes: Production list/auth polish exists and fixture evidence is safe, but live owner list proof remains blocked until a commit-safe owner session is available.

stages.label: Meeting detail transcript, playback, and provenance
stages.notes: Ready/partial/processing/failed detail states are fixture-backed; live private detail and governance proof remains blocked by missing approved owner-session evidence.

stages.label: Notes and action output
stages.notes: The interface exposes structured notes/action truth states; launchable generated notes/action output remains unaccepted.

stages.label: Desktop embedded cabinet
stages.notes: Installed desktop product polish and final /Applications capture-state walkthrough evidence are current; broad launch remains blocked by web, notes/action, and production rollout gaps.

stages.label: Access, sharing, download, and export
stages.notes: Access/egress policy is accepted and locally regressed with bounded artifact actions.

stages.label: Retention, deletion, and local purge truth
stages.notes: Deletion reports, dependency limits, post-egress limits, and local purge acknowledgements are locally regressed as metadata-only truth.

stages.label: Production deployment and smoke boundary
stages.notes: Production evidence proves infra_smoke_ready, not pilot or user rollout readiness.

stages.label: Product status and next-slice truth
stages.notes: The generated 036 readiness pack records the current bounded claim and remaining live-proof gaps.
